description: This file defines the ContentInfoActivity class for an Android TV app, responsible for displaying detailed content information including metadata, background, action buttons, date/time, and handling user interactions such as play, schedule, record, favorite, block, and subtitles. It also includes network calls to initiate media playback.

classes.name: ContentInfoActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that shows detailed content info with metadata, background, focusable action buttons, and network-based media playback.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, date/time, content data, and action button focus/behavior.

methods.name: setupSystemDateTime
methods.description: Displays current system date and time in designated TextViews.

methods.name: populateContentData
methods.description: Populates UI with content metadata received via Intent extras or defaults.

methods.name: setupActionButtons
methods.description: Configures focusable action buttons with icons, labels, focus animations, and click handlers.

methods.name: animateButtonFocus
methods.description: Animates visual focus cues on action buttons when focus state changes.

methods.name: handleButtonAction
methods.description: Handles user presses on action buttons, with visual feedback and invoking specific functions.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Manages D-PAD navigation and selection, as well as back button handling.

methods.name: handlePlay
methods.description: Performs GET request to /api/play to fetch media URL and launches video player with fallback handling.

methods.name: extractUrlFromResponse
methods.description: Parses the response body to extract media URL, supporting JSON format and direct URL.

methods.name: isValidHttpUrl
methods.description: Checks if given string is a well-formed HTTP or HTTPS URL.

methods.name: createIntent
methods.description: Factory method to create an Intent to launch ContentInfoActivity with specified content metadata.
